  "text": "Mara had meant to go to the orchard on Monday. By noon, clouds had covered the hills. Bristle followed her from room to room as she folded sheets and put them away, hopeful each time she passed the hook where his lead hung. That night the wind lifted the loose edge of the shed roof. Mara heard it from her bed and made a list in her head: a nail for the roof, more logs indoors, a reply about the branches.
